{{Quote|Okay Zeer, let's get into position before we send him back to the bosom of his family|Clone Captain Rex, referring to a super battle droid Zeer programmed to explode on his command|<ref name="TCWn" />}}
'''Zeer''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and a member in [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he served as one of Torrent Company's combat engineers and was one of six [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to survive the battle.

==Biography==
Zeer was the taken name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] combat engineer within [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], assigned to the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]'s [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] of the battle-hardened [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="TCWn" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates both the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]], which depicts the debut of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]], in which Zeer appears, to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Since the latter work depicts Zeer as a [[clone trooper]] in the Grand Army of the Republic during the [[Battle of Teth]], he must have also appeared in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> he was assigned to a strike force tasked to recapture [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], the offspring of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] indicated that the Huttlet was being held in a former [[B'omarr Monastery]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Teth/Legends|Teth]].<ref name="Teth Databank">{{SWE|locations|teth|Teth}}</ref><ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

===Attacking the monastery===
{{Quote|You have to know the provenance of information to evaluate it. In other words, who wants you to know this? Who doesn't? And why? If you come by sensitive information too easily, it might be planted. So if you check out Teth, go carefully.|Lieutenant N-6 "Kom'rk", commenting on the operation planned for Teth|<ref name="TCWn" />}}
[[File:Clone_trooper_pilot_lieutenant.png|thumb|left|250px|Republic forces landed under heavy fire on Teth.]]
[[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Gunships]] deployed the 501st troopers into the target area under heavy fire, landing the men of Torrent Company at the base of the monastery. Located on a massive cliff, the monastery was protected by a variety of Confederacy forces. Determined to complete their mission, Torrent Company—including Zeer<ref name="TCWn" />—began the ascent up the cliff face, led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. They took heavy casualties in the process, including one of their [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer|AT-TEs]], but they were able to take control of the monastery. Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], successfully captured the Huttlet, but the Republic force came under attack by numerous [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and were subjected to strafing from [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]]. Torrent Company suffered heavy casualties, along with their remaining AT-TE walker.<ref name="TCWf" />

===A desperate defense===
[[File:Torrent_company_on_teth.png|thumb|right|250px|Torrent Company prepares to defend the monastery at all costs.]]
The remaining [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers of Torrent Company prepared a desperate defense against the inevitable Confederacy assault. Skywalker and Tano retreated to evacuate the Huttlet, while Torrent Company deployed explosive ordinance and [[Tripwire/Legends|tripwires]] to slow the Separatist attack. Shortly after the Jedi retreated, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces overrode the door controls to the monastery and instantly began the assault on the remaining troopers, who numbered just a quarter of the force they deployed with. The clones managed to inflict heavy casualties, but were eradicated with the exception of six troopers, including Zeer.<ref name="TCWn" />

===Last stand===
{{Quote|I don't get it, if this had been Jabiim, they'd have been all over us by now and our heads would be stuck on poles. What's stopping the tinnies from doing that? They know how few men we've got because they were guarding us.''"<br />"''They're dumb, at least, the regular tinnies are. If they're not lined up in a row and just firing, they're lost. I don't think the SBDs are that much smarter.''"<br />"''This barve wasn't, for a start. But he's got a new outlook on life.|Zeer and Del, discussing their predicament as Zeer reprograms a super battle droid to explode among Confederacy forces|<ref name="TCWn" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_Teth_1.png|thumb|left|250px|The survivors of Torrent Company use a fallen AT-TE for cover.]]
The last six clone troopers—Clone [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], Clone [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Coric]], [[Attie]], [[Del (clone trooper)|Del]], [[Nax/Legends|Nax]], and Zeer—were taken prisoner by the Separatist troops, and were left outside the monastery under guard. When Rex received a transmission from Skywalker, the clones used the distraction to turn on their captors, destroying a number of the droids and taking their weapons. The survivors took cover upon the destroyed AT-TE as more battle droids responded to their escape and moved to intercept the last members of Torrent Company. Zeer put his skills as a combat engineer to use, rigging a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droid]] with explosives, and programming it to return to its fellow droids, allowing Zeer to detonate it. The detonation inflicted heavy casualties, but the Separatist forces relentlessly assaulted the clone's position.<ref name="TCWn" /> As the droids continued to encroach upon the clones' position, a squadron of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], led by Jedi General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], opened fire on the attacking battle droids, destroying the ones nearest to Torrent Company's position. Shortly after, the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] began landing reinforcements,<ref name="TCWf" /> and was able to repel the droid attack, saving Zeer and the last five members of Torrent Company.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Republic—one; Confederacy of Independent Systems—nil.''"<br />"''Well that worked rather well..., I wonder if they'll fall for it again?|Nax and Zeer, discussing Zeer's successful reprogramming and subsequent detonation of a super battle droid among Confederacy ranks|<ref name="TCWn" />}}
Zeer was trained as a combat engineer in the Grand Army, and was capable of setting detailed explosive traps, such as the super battle droid he wired to explode upon reaching its fellow droids.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|New and improved, removes those ''difficult'', ground-in tinnies that other flamethrowers can't touch.|Zeer, commenting on a flamethrower he had retrieved and customized for better effect|<ref name="TCWn" />}}
As a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] clone of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Zeer stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. Zeer maintained his composure even under extreme duress from Confederacy forces, and was notably modest about his mechanical talent. Clone Captain CT-7567 also noted that he seemed to default to a dictionary "stock phrases" when under pressure, as if he was too hyped up or scared to think, and instead needed a script.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zeer first appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="TCWn" />
